title: Maharashtra Right to Information (Second Amendment) Rules, 2012
issuer: Government of Maharashtra, General Administration Department
excerpt: The amendment establishes a supervised record-inspection procedure, including use of pencil only and no marking of records.
notes: Notification dated 31 January 2012, reproduced from Maharashtra Gazette Extraordinary Part IV-A dated 2 February 2012 in an official MSEDCL compilation.
